protocol: Only Gradient Boosting fitted. No Ridge or other linear estimator is imported, fitted or selected. No tuning on test months. Fixed original windows with available own-source days only: counts differ from earlier runs because 2024 and excluded days are absent. Two targets trained separately. Same-day observed weather is an idealized retrospective input; earlier test observations supply later calendar-correct lags. No median imputation; incomplete feature rows are excluded.
limitations: Previously inspected test months, not an untouched final test. Test dates are reduced by cleaning/history requirements; compare prior predictions only on identical dates. No donor workbook or donor-derived merged training table is used.
